Z3CDVLBOgCwhmH0ZoYQQKw.zh: 斐濟疫情嚴峻,2025年新增2,016例感染病例,每60名成年人中即有1名為感染者,多為靜脈注射毒品共用針頭以及不安全性行為而傳播,疫情惡化主因為低保險套使用率、缺乏篩檢、多重性伴侶及污名化不敢就醫等,且有2%孕婦感染,母嬰垂直感染風險高。當局已於9/15宣布疫情進入國家緊急狀態,將擴大篩檢、推動暴露前預防性投藥(PrEP)並進行針具交換計畫。
Z3CDVLBOgCwhmH0ZoYQQKw.en: Fiji's epidemic is severe: 2,016 new infections were recorded in 2025, meaning 1 in every 60 adults is infected. Transmission is mainly through sharing injection drug needles and unsafe sexual practices. The worsening is attributed to low condom use, lack of screening, multiple sexual partners, and stigma that deters people from seeking care; 2% of pregnant women are infected, and the risk of mother-to-child transmission is high. On 15 September the authorities declared a national state of emergency, and will expand screening, promote pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and implement needle and syringe exchange programmes.

LmbSOcDfQX8YmeG7CzT1YA.zh: 斐濟過去30年累計確診不到千例,惟去年即遽增逾2,000例,疫情已從低盛行率轉為全面性流行。疫情升溫主因係靜脈注射毒品者共用針頭,同步帶動C肝散播,感染群體亦擴及性工作者及一般異性戀族群。此外,孕婦及兒童感染率攀升,突顯延誤篩檢問題。當局已將全國照護團隊自3個擴增至17個,並呼籲臨床端及早識別,強化早期篩檢與即時治療。
LmbSOcDfQX8YmeG7CzT1YA.en: Fiji recorded fewer than 1,000 confirmed cases cumulatively over the past 30 years, but last year alone cases rose by more than 2,000, and the epidemic has shifted from low prevalence to a generalised epidemic. The surge is mainly driven by needle sharing among people who inject drugs, which has also spread hepatitis C. Infection has extended to sex workers and the general heterosexual population. In addition, infection rates among pregnant women and children are rising, highlighting the problem of delayed testing. Authorities have expanded the national care teams from three to 17 and call on clinicians to identify cases early and strengthen early screening and immediate treatment.

DckfSOhGEtvkLCGQJziICA.zh: 斐濟於去(2025)年新增2,003例確定病例,另有59例嬰兒於出生時感染,該國於去年1月宣布全國爆發愛滋病疫情,主要原因為注射毒品者共用針頭及年輕人病例數增加。當局成立國家應變工作小組,惟人力缺乏,以致影響應變能力。該國2024年報告1,583例確定病例。
DckfSOhGEtvkLCGQJziICA.en: Fiji reported 2,003 new confirmed cases last year, and another 59 infants were infected at birth. In January last year (2025), the country declared a nationwide HIV epidemic, mainly due to needle-sharing among people who inject drugs and an increase in cases among young people. Authorities established a national response task force, but a shortage of staff has affected response capacity. The country reported 1,583 confirmed cases in 2024.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

ZNPDwjghOUjpusfxfHTvkA.zh: WHO西太平洋區3國病例數急遽增加,斐濟過去10年新增感染病例上升10倍,主要感染途徑為注射毒品,另有傳播至其他太平洋島國之疑慮;菲律賓自2010-24年新增感染病例增加6倍,主要感染族群為男男性行為者;巴布亞紐幾內亞宣布愛滋病毒感染為國家危機,以應對育齡婦女和兒童族群不斷上升之感染率。WHO及聯合國已召開會議,以因應該區愛滋病危機,並探討解決行動方案。 印度東部賈坎德邦柴巴薩市某醫院於10月爆發5名地中海貧血兒童,經輸血感染愛滋病毒事件,首例於9/13接受輸血,5週後(10/18)檢測陽性,經調查5名病患血型不相同,顯示為多名捐血者血液遭汙染,感染源調查中,另該院血庫與實驗室有多項違規事項,當局已宣布該院血庫僅提供緊急情況使用。
ZNPDwjghOUjpusfxfHTvkA.en: WHO's Western Pacific Region reports sharp increases in case numbers in three countries. In Fiji, new HIV infections have risen tenfold over the past 10 years, mainly through injecting drug use, and there are concerns about spread to other Pacific island countries. In the Philippines, new infections increased sixfold between 2010 and 2024, mainly among men who have sex with men. Papua New Guinea has declared HIV a national crisis to respond to rising infection rates among women of reproductive age and children. WHO and the United Nations have convened meetings to address the regional HIV crisis and discuss action plans. In India, at a hospital in Chaibasa city, Jharkhand state in eastern India, five children with thalassaemia were infected with HIV through blood transfusions in October. The first child received a transfusion on 13 September and tested positive five weeks later, on 18 October. Investigation found that the five patients had different blood types, indicating that blood from several donors was contaminated. The source of infection is under investigation. The hospital's blood bank and laboratory were found to have multiple violations, and authorities have announced that the hospital's blood bank will only provide blood for emergencies.

GkZNDHn0Wlwi2tbKkCMHKw.zh: 斐濟今年1月宣布爆發疫情,去年報告1,583例確定病例,今年截至5月新增逾800例,推估至今年年底預計新增逾3,000例。該國已累計近9,000例感染者,其中近一半感染者未接受治療或已失聯,該國另有抗病毒藥物庫存短缺問題。該國主要傳染途徑為毒品注射(48%)及性接觸(40%),當局已啟動針頭交換及暴露前預防(PrEP)等新預防措施。
GkZNDHn0Wlwi2tbKkCMHKw.en: Fiji declared an outbreak in January this year. Last year, 1,583 confirmed cases were reported; from January to May this year, more than 800 new cases were added, and projections indicate more than 3,000 new cases by the end of this year. The country has accumulated nearly 9,000 infected people, and nearly half of them are untreated or have been lost to follow-up. The country also faces a shortage of antiretroviral drug stocks. The main routes of transmission are drug injection (48%) and sexual contact (40%). Authorities have launched new prevention measures, including needle and syringe exchange and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP).

ne3BGKWPv3AuwqNUzKaV2A.zh: 斐濟疫情更新,今年迄今累計逾5,100例病例及3例死亡,病例主要分布於該國西部及中部,主要流行型別為DENV-2及DENV-3,今年病例數已高於去年全年2,033例,疫情可能因雨季而持續上升。 烏拉圭今年迄今累計2例本土病例,病例分布於蒙特維多及派桑杜,當局於疫區加強防治措施;該國去年報告1例本土病例,為2020年以來首例本土病例。
ne3BGKWPv3AuwqNUzKaV2A.en: Fiji update: so far this year, more than 5,100 cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the west and centre of the country. The main circulating serotypes are DENV-2 and DENV-3. This year's case count already exceeds the 2,033 cases for the whole of last year, and the outbreak may continue to rise during the rainy season. Uruguay has reported 2 locally acquired cases so far this year, in Montevideo and Paysandú; authorities have strengthened control measures in the affected areas. The country reported 1 locally acquired case last year, its first since 2020.

wInRkg2NafpQxJWvhWXrVg.zh: 斐濟爆發疫情,去年1-9月已報告1,093例病例,病例數為前年同期的3倍,前5年的9倍。病患當中有223例與毒品濫用相關,202例為性傳播,餘仍在調查中,當局已針對毒品使用者提出介入措施。
wInRkg2NafpQxJWvhWXrVg.en: Fiji is experiencing an outbreak: from January to September last year, 1,093 cases were reported, three times the same period of the previous year and nine times the average for the same period over the previous five years. Of these cases, 223 are associated with drug abuse and 202 were sexually transmitted; the remainder are still under investigation. Authorities have introduced interventions targeting drug users.
